tooltip.moretnt.lumber_tnt: Only removes logs, wood, and leaves.
tooltip.moretnt.soil_tnt: Only removes dirt, sand, gravel, clay, and mud.
tooltip.moretnt.stone_tnt: Only removes common stone and deepslate.
tooltip.moretnt.ore_miner_tnt: Mines ores only, including most modded ores.
tooltip.moretnt.ore_safe_tnt: Demolishes non-ore blocks while protecting ores.
tooltip.moretnt.crop_tnt: Harvests crops, flowers, and vines only.
tooltip.moretnt.glass_tnt: Removes glass blocks and panes only.
tooltip.moretnt.wool_tnt: Removes wool, carpets, and beds only.
tooltip.moretnt.concrete_tnt: Removes concrete, powder, and terracotta only.
tooltip.moretnt.nether_tnt: Removes netherrack, basalt, and blackstone only.
tooltip.moretnt.endstone_tnt: Removes end stone and purpur blocks only.
tooltip.moretnt.wood_tnt: Removes wooden building blocks without touching ores.
tooltip.moretnt.water_tnt: Fills nearby air spaces with water sources.
tooltip.moretnt.lava_tnt: Fills nearby air spaces with lava.
tooltip.moretnt.frost_tnt: Turns nearby water sources into ice.
tooltip.moretnt.glow_tnt: Right-click to throw; the detonation places exactly one glowstone.
tooltip.moretnt.tunnel_tnt: Excavates breakable terrain into a 3x3 north-south tunnel.
tooltip.moretnt.shaft_tnt: Excavates breakable terrain into a 3x3 vertical shaft.
tooltip.moretnt.quarry_tnt: Mines stone and ores while preserving containers.
tooltip.moretnt.surface_tnt: Clears ordinary blocks from the detonation Y-level upward; blast-proof blocks remain.
tooltip.moretnt.demolition_tnt: General demolition that protects ores and containers.
tooltip.moretnt.mega_tnt: A large-radius (16) normal explosion. Keep clear!
tooltip.moretnt.colossal_tnt: A huge-radius (48) explosion. Use only in open areas!
tooltip.moretnt.obsidian_tnt: Breaks obsidian, crying obsidian, and respawn anchors.
tooltip.moretnt.bedrock_tnt: Breaks bedrock within radius 4. Bedrock never drops.
tooltip.moretnt.void_tnt: Clears blocks without drops; protects ores and containers.
tooltip.moretnt.glowstone_light_arrow: Creates one glowstone on block impact; makes hit creatures glow for 10 seconds.
tooltip.moretnt.nuclear_tnt: Nuclear: devastating radius-64 explosion. Use only in a backed-up open test area.
tooltip.moretnt.super_nuclear_tnt: Super-nuclear: extreme radius-96 explosion. Permanently reshapes terrain and can cause lag.
